gate.entity_policy: Only Checker-selected visible record IDs identify cited canonical entities; no unselected-record or Analyzer-name anchor. Equal vectors do not establish equal physical entities.
gate.physical_correctness_scope: A passed contract is not a theorem of physical correctness. Record ID and coordinate checks establish citation consistency; semantic relevance/applicability in the reason and internal-reasoning physics remain model judgements.

candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: ks (equivalent sand-grain roughness) and Ra (first-order absolute moment of height fluctuations) are both lengths, so their ratio ks/Ra is dimensionless. Given the provided input variables, the independent inputs are either lengths (Ra, kt, k_rms) or dimensionless shape/porosity/slope descriptors (Sk, Ku, ES, Po). Therefore exponents for length-based inputs are L=1 and all other base exponents zero; for the inherently dimensionless inputs all seven base exponents are zero.

the kurtosis of roughness height fluctuations, Ku;
the effective streamwise slope of the roughness, ES;
the surface porosity, Po.
